Avalee Lenard is a data maestro!

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "loess", se = FALSE,
              color = "#3B2F63", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C", end = 0.9) +
  labs(
    title = "Bigger engines, fewer highway miles",
    subtitle = "Engine displacement and highway fuel economy across vehicle classes",
    x = "Engine displacement (liters)",
    y = "Highway fuel economy (miles per gallon)",
    color = "Vehicle class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
